name: Asiatic Tearthumb
desc: Asiatic Tearthumb (Persicaria perfoliata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Persicaria perfoliata is a species of flowering plant in the buckwheat family. Common names include mile-a-minute, devil's tail, giant climbing tearthumb, and Asiatic tearthumb.
